_doc: Final Fight victim postures (export_bm.VICTIM_POSES['ffight'], the vocabulary of tools/kof96/victim_poses98.json: posture + angle, ROM sprites face left once exported, 0 upright, 90 horizontal head toward the facing side, 180 head down). Keys 'B' + Bred's frame record (hex) as FF draws him in the measured throws (rec_ff.py, throws_ff.py); read by eye from the frames (2026-10-14, sheet /data/tmp/ffight/bred.png); his standing frames count as 'grabbed' (they show only while he is held, and the Lab shell's posture vocabulary has no 'standing'). 'getup': his get-up frames (the throw rows' role 'getup').
